listings.title: Luxury 5–6 BR Architectural Villa, Ulu Art Bay
listings.summary: A three-level contemporary Mediterranean estate by SUKYF Studio in the limestone hills of Uluwatu, with a 123 m² pool and rooftop wellness lounge.
listings.description:
Set within the 21-villa Ulu Art Bay estate, Villa Adonis brings together contemporary Mediterranean architecture, tropical landscaping and art-led interiors.

The residence offers five en-suite bedrooms with the option of a sixth bedroom, home office or studio, dual master suites, a media room and a gallery hall. Floor-to-ceiling openings connect the open-plan living, kitchen and dining areas to the pool, a sunken lounge and a BBQ deck. A private rooftop lounge with jacuzzi completes the home.

Buyers can choose from three interior concepts: Minimal Modern, Mediterranean Luxe or Bohemian Artist.
highlights: 123 m² private pool and sunken lounge
Smart-home features, gated security, concierge and management
Ownership stated as HGB; confirm title with your notary
listings.yield_note: Developer projects 7–9% net rental yield at 60–80% occupancy. This is the developer's estimate, not a guaranteed return.

listings.title: Turnkey 2 BR Villa with Rooftop Lounge
listings.summary: An exclusive gated development of 12 villas in a quieter part of Canggu, delivered fully furnished with a private pool and rooftop lounge.
listings.description:
A two-bedroom, two-bathroom villa arranged over two levels, with a private pool and sun deck, open-plan living behind floor-to-ceiling glass, and a private rooftop lounge with an ice-bath area.

Finishes include matte granite flooring, cement-wash walls, natural andesite stone, teak flooring and timber panelling, with smart-home integration. The villa is offered fully furnished and turnkey, with milestone-based payment options.

Available units:
- Villa 5: USD 300,000 · 155 m² building · 62.5 m² land
- Villa 11: USD 270,000 · 147 m² building · 59.57 m² land
- Villa 12: USD 270,000 · 155 m² building · 54.3 m² land
highlights: Only 12 villas in the gated development
Private pool, sun deck and rooftop lounge

listings.title: Ready 4 BR Architectural Villa with Rooftop Terrace
listings.summary: Villa Via is a completed, fully furnished four-bedroom home in the Tiying Tutul area of Tumbak Bayuh, close to Canggu and Pererenan.
listings.description:
Positioned on approximately 650 m² of land with a 342 m² building, Villa Via combines clean contemporary architecture, expansive floor-to-ceiling glass and generous indoor-outdoor spaces across several levels.

A private pool, jacuzzi and rooftop terrace give room for sunset drinks and entertaining. The villa is offered fully furnished and turnkey, so a new owner can move in or begin operating without waiting for construction. Professional villa management is available.
highlights: Approx. 342 m² building on 650 m² land
Private pool, jacuzzi and rooftop terrace
Quiet Tiying Tutul location, near Canggu and Pererenan

listings.title: Spacious 3 BR Private Pool Villa, Prime Location
listings.price_note: 5–10 min to Batu Bolong & Echo Beach
listings.summary: A three-bedroom private pool villa in central Canggu, a short ride from Batu Bolong and Echo Beach.
listings.description:
A spacious three-bedroom, three-bathroom villa with a private pool, set on approximately 177 m² of land with around 166 m² of living space.

The location puts Batu Bolong and Echo Beach, Canggu's cafés and beach clubs within roughly 5–10 minutes, which suits both private use and short-stay rental. Ask me for the floor plan, lease details and full photo set.
highlights: 5–10 minutes to Batu Bolong and Echo Beach

listings.title: Completed 2 BR Apartment, Steps from Batu Belig Beach
listings.summary: Kiara Ocean Place is a completed, operating serviced-apartment development between Seminyak and Berawa, about 30 seconds from Batu Belig Beach.
listings.description:
Set on a 3,500 m² tourism-zoned site with 62 residences, Kiara Ocean Place sits around 30 seconds from Batu Belig Beach and Café del Mar, three minutes from Potato Head Beach Club and about 30 minutes from the airport.

Current availability:
- 1-bedroom apartment, 80 m²: IDR 3,400,000,000
- 2-bedroom apartment, 158 m²: IDR 6,555,000,000

Residents have two shared pools, a gym, a co-working business centre, lobby and concierge, 24-hour security and an optional rental-management program. Units are delivered semi-furnished, with turnkey furniture packages available.

listings.title: Absolute Beachfront Serviced Apartments
listings.summary: Kiara Beachtown is a premium serviced-apartment development directly on the white sand of Nusa Dua Beach.
listings.description:
The development comprises 98 apartments in one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts from 83 m² to 223 m², with selected units facing the ocean or the courtyard.

Facilities include direct beach access, a beachfront infinity pool and garden pool, a Mediterranean restaurant, tiki bar and sports bar, gym and spa, kids' and teens' clubs, co-working space, underground parking, a water-sports station and an optional rental-management program.

The location is about five minutes from Club Med Bali, ten minutes from Bali National Golf Club and twenty minutes from the airport.
highlights: Absolute beachfront on Nusa Dua Beach
30% down payment, payment plan up to three months
Resort facilities and optional rental management
